household_types.description: A group of international students, often from China, India, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, or Vietnam, sharing a rented apartment or house to reduce living costs. Typical ages 20-24, enrolled at Monash University. High multilingualism and education levels, with part-time work common.
household_types.housing_hint: Rented apartment or house with multiple bedrooms, often in high-rise or older units, near public transport and university.

household_types.description: Young couples without children, often early-career professionals or postgraduate students, living together in a rented or mortgaged unit. Both partners may work full-time or part-time, with median age 25-34 and moderate income.
household_types.housing_hint: Rented or owner-occupied apartment or townhouse, typically 2 bedrooms, close to amenities and transport.

household_types.description: A family with children, often of Chinese or Indian ancestry, where parents may be recent migrants or established residents. Home ownership or renting a separate house. Children may be in school or younger, and education is highly valued.
household_types.housing_hint: Separate house or townhouse, often with 3 or more bedrooms, either owned with a mortgage or rented, in a quiet street.
